about: BN4 Red Sun's GutsSoul (Soul 2, form 2) in BN4's own battle on the guest core against BN6's with GutsSoul moved (docs/multirom/bn4-souls.md): BN4's family 0x12 an attack unit of tools/xchiprecipe_bn4.py at BN6's grown 0xD8, its power attack 0x24 copied with it, his hand's pass as he enters (src/emu/soulbn4.c soulbn4_enter, its numbers read from BN4_GUTS_PASS), his kind panel-cracking by BN4's own kind of the chip (soulkinds_bn4_of). BN4 holds the Soul (souls4) and a deck of two PanlSht1 A (BN4's 178, kind 8, its power 100 shown); BN6 holds it (souls6 bit 7: BN6's Soul 14 over the proxy form) and the same two (the moved PanlSht1, BN6's 559). The first Custom screen picks both, moves to UNITE (four right, down), takes it and the Soul (up, A). B held from fight frame 30 for 102 frames, two past its charge of 100, its release the charged shot (each B press counted toward his rapid buster, one press of six, BN4's alone); A at fight frame 200 fires the first PanlSht1 (100 + 30), after the charged shot, since BN6's support run holds MegaMan's own clock a frame on from it (megaman_clock) while B's press keeps the battle's. A MettaurSP at (4,2), MegaMan at (3,2) before it, so his charged shot, a punch at the panel ahead (power attack 0x24: 60 at its +8), strikes it, with 2000 HP, kept from harm.
